caption: The drawing depicts a bonnet made of shiny, silver-gray fabric with horizontal quilting. The bonnet has a gathered, ruched texture throughout, giving it a padded, segmented appearance. On the right side, there is a wide, pale pink ribbon that ties into a bow below the bonnet, featuring three sets of parallel dark lines running vertically along each trailing end. Another pink ribbon, more loosely tied and draped, is attached to the right side of the bonnet. The overall composition centers the bonnet in the image against a plain, off-white background. The artist's name, "GERTRUDE LEMBERG," is written in small, uppercase letters near the lower left corner of the image.
title: Woman's Hood
